title: Acousto-optic plane P pulse in silica (analytic)
description:
A traction sheet across a y-periodic silica strip (elastic_waves) launches a plane longitudinal Ricker pulse to each side; the photoelastic strain is handed to a sourceless em_fdfd_ez (acoustics_em_acousto_optic), which re-solves every 100 acoustic steps (stroboscopic) and once more at the end. The absorbing layers of both physics sit in the EM CPML padding (100 cells), outside the drawn domain.
Analytic (1D wave): v_x = T / (2 rho c) w(t - 4/f0 - |x - x_s| / c), w the Ricker wavelet (1 - 2 a^2) exp(-a^2), a = pi f0 tau; e_xx = -sign(x - x_s) T / (2 rho c^2) w; plane strain e_yy = e_zz = 0, so the E_z index shift is dn = -n0^3 / 2 p12 e_xx and eps_r = (n0 + dn)^2.
Probes tab: acoustics.near / far (v_x) with the dashed Ricker curves; their FFTs against |V(f)| = T / (2 rho c) 2 f^2 / (sqrt(pi) f0^3) exp(-f^2 / f0^2).
Line profile tab (final state, t_end): strain_profile on acoustics.elastic_strain_xx and eps_profile on em.eps_r (the right-going pulse near x = 38 um; the left one has left through the x_lo layer).
Derived values tab: peak v_x near / far, a flank value of the far probe (tests the speed), min elastic strain and max / min of sqrt(eps_r) - n0 against their closed forms; expected ~0.1-0.5 % (float32 eps rounding ~4e-4 of dn, dispersion < 1e-4 at 30+ cells per wavelength).

parameters.name: f0
parameters.description: Ricker peak frequency

parameters.name: t_d
parameters.description: time of the Ricker maximum at the sheet (the waveform's t0)

parameters.name: T_sheet
parameters.description: peak traction of the sheet in Pa (normal, along +x)

parameters.name: rho_glass
parameters.description: silica density in kg/m^3

parameters.name: cL_glass
parameters.description: longitudinal (P) speed in m/s

parameters.name: cS_glass
parameters.description: shear (S) speed in m/s (not excited by a normal traction)

parameters.name: eps_glass
parameters.description: relative permittivity at 1.55 um (n0 = 1.444)

parameters.name: n_glass
parameters.description: unperturbed index n0 (the E13 reference index)

parameters.name: p11_glass
parameters.description: photoelastic coefficient p11

parameters.name: p12_glass
parameters.description: photoelastic coefficient p12 (the only one an x strain gives eps_zz)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solves

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (119 cells per P wavelength at f0)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length (window; the absorbing layers lie outside it)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: strip height (periodic y: every wave stays plane)

parameters.name: y_mid
parameters.description: y of the probes and the profile lines (a cell centre)

parameters.name: x_s
parameters.description: traction sheet position (cell centre)

parameters.name: x_near
parameters.description: near probe cell centre (v_x sits on its +x face)

parameters.name: x_far
parameters.description: far probe cell centre

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: study duration; the right pulse is then centred near x = 37.8 um

parameters.name: A_v
parameters.description: peak particle velocity T / (2 rho c) in m/s (3.81)

parameters.name: A_strain
parameters.description: peak strain magnitude T / (2 rho c^2) (6.4e-4)

parameters.name: dn_peak
parameters.description: peak index rise n0^3 p12 |e_xx| / 2 (2.6e-4)

parameters.name: delay_near
parameters.description: pulse centre time at the near probe face

parameters.name: delay_far
parameters.description: pulse centre time at the far probe face

parameters.name: t_flank
parameters.description: far-probe flank time (a = 0.5: w = 0.5 exp(-0.25))

analytic_curves.name: strain_profile
analytic_curves.expression: -sign(x - x_s)*A_strain*(1 - 2*(pi*f0*(t_end - t_d - abs(x - x_s)/cL_glass))**2)*exp(-(pi*f0*(t_end - t_d - abs(x - x_s)/cL_glass))**2)

analytic_curves.name: eps_profile
analytic_curves.expression: (n_glass + dn_peak*sign(x - x_s)*(1 - 2*(pi*f0*(t_end - t_d - abs(x - x_s)/cL_glass))**2)*exp(-(pi*f0*(t_end - t_d - abs(x - x_s)/cL_glass))**2))**2
